_comment: The curated project list. Edit this, not the README: scripts/render.mjs redraws a card per entry and rebuilds the table between the projects markers. Order here is the order shown.

projects.title: zusia
projects.blurb: A study buddy inside Zotero. Ask Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity about the paper on screen; get LaTeX, drawings and proofs back.

projects.title: zagreus-italic-challenge

projects.title: parkinson-handwriting-dl

projects.title: codeforces
